roleDefinitions.superAdmin: Platform-wide authority; currently reserved-email based and targeted for immutable-ID plus MFA replacement.
roleDefinitions.genericAdmin: user_roles admin authority; distinct from Super Admin and targeted for trust-site-by-trust-site replacement pending decisions.
roleDefinitions.schoolAdmin: School/tenant-scoped authority; must not imply generic admin or Super Admin.

paths.exactAuthority: Validates a shared pre-authentication code that the client reuses as the reserved identity password; successful reserved-identity authentication receives backend Super Admin authority through email-based trust.
paths.disablementImpact: Breaks the current reserved Super Admin sign-in/sign-up entry path; ordinary authentication is not expected to depend on it.

paths.exactAuthority: Returns verification and lockout state used to set a browser session flag; backend authority already derives from the reserved JWT email.

definitions.signature: public.verify_super_admin_code(p_email text, p_code text, p_device_fingerprint text default null, p_user_agent text default null)
public.verify_super_admin_code(p_email text, p_code text, p_device_fingerprint text default null, p_user_agent text default null)

paths.disablementImpact: Breaks the current Super Admin verification page but does not revoke reserved-email backend authority.

paths.exactAuthority: Adds persistent generic admin authority to a caller-supplied target UUID.
paths.repositoryReachability: RPC definition and generated/client reference found; deployed grants not verified
paths.disablementImpact: No confirmed active UI dependency; direct or external code-based generic-admin provisioning would stop.

paths.authorityClass: School Admin activation plus generic admin side effect
paths.exactAuthority: Binds the authenticated user to school/profile state, creates School Admin membership, and also inserts generic admin authority through service-role writes.
paths.disablementImpact: Breaks new school activation; existing School Admin records remain.
